labs/pg-barchart.title: Bar height encodes one value
labs/pg-barchart.description: Three build stages become three bars; no other chart type competes for attention.
walkthrough: BarChart receives category/value pairs and maps each value to a vertical mark. The labels and values belong to the chart itself.
animateIn reveals the same three bars from their baseline. It does not replace the dataset or introduce a second encoding.
experiments: Change only Bundle from 5 to 8 and predict which bar changes.

labs/pg-graph.title: A directed three-node graph
labs/pg-graph.description: Two edges make the direction A to B to C immediately readable.
walkthrough: Graph owns three GraphNode instances and two directed GraphEdge instances.
applyLayout assigns explicit positions once. There is no force simulation, path-finding or layout morph in this scene.
experiments: Reverse the second edge and inspect its arrow direction.

labs/pg-automaton.title: A DFA for strings ending in 1
labs/pg-automaton.description: Two states and four transitions express one complete deterministic rule.
walkthrough: State 0 is the start state and state 1 is accepting. Reading 1 moves to the accepting state; reading 0 moves to state 0.
The scene shows only the automaton topology. Tape playback and runner controls are intentionally omitted.
experiments: Swap the accepting state to recognize strings ending in 0.

labs/pg-physics2d.title: One dynamic body under gravity
labs/pg-physics2d.description: A ball falls, collides with a fixed floor and rebounds.
walkthrough: Physics2D owns one static rectangle and one dynamic circle. Gravity changes only the dynamic body.
Restitution controls the rebound after contact; no joints, walls or extra bodies obscure the collision.
experiments: Set restitution to 0 and compare the first impact.

labs/pg-subdivision.title: Sample one polyline more densely
labs/pg-subdivision.description: Amber points expose exactly what subdividePolyline adds between three control points.
walkthrough: SubdivisionEngine subdivides each source segment until no result segment exceeds maxSegmentLength.
The cyan line and amber dots use the returned samples directly. No smoothing or deformation is applied.
experiments: Double maxSegmentLength and compare the number of amber samples.

labs/pg-procedural-star.title: One procedural star
labs/pg-procedural-star.description: Five points, two radii and one corner radius define the complete shape.
walkthrough: Star generates its contour from the supplied parameters and remains ordinary vector geometry afterward.
Create reveals that one contour. The scene contains no shape gallery or 3D model.
experiments: Change points from 5 to 7 while keeping both radii fixed.

labs/pg-shader-uniform.title: One uniform drives one shader ring
labs/pg-shader-uniform.description: A single float changes the radius calculated by the fragment shader.
walkthrough: The Pulse struct occupies one aligned uniform buffer. Each update writes only its radius value.
The fragment shader compares each pixel's distance from the center with that radius, producing one moving ring.
experiments: Hold radius at 0.3 to separate uniform animation from shader evaluation.

labs/pg-render-target.title: Render once, display as a texture
labs/pg-render-target.description: A moving offscreen circle appears only through the target's texture.
walkthrough: RenderTarget captures the circle into a 256 by 256 offscreen texture.
Sprite displays that texture in the main scene. The amber frame is ordinary main-scene geometry and is not captured.
experiments: Stop moving the captured circle and verify the displayed texture becomes static.

labs/pg-image.title: Display one raster image
labs/pg-image.description: RTImage loads a single asset and presents it at an explicit world-space size.
walkthrough: The source path identifies the image asset; width and height control only its displayed quad.
No video playback, atlas slicing or material mapping is involved.
experiments: Change the displayed width without changing the source image.

labs/pg-noise.title: Sample one Perlin noise function
labs/pg-noise.description: One deterministic noise source becomes one curve on mathematical axes.
walkthrough: PerlinNoise evaluates a scalar for each x coordinate requested by FunctionGraph2D.
The fixed seed keeps the curve reproducible. No additional noise families, octaves or vector fields are combined.
experiments: Change only scale from 1.2 to 2.4 and compare feature spacing.

labs/pg-msdf-font.title: Load and use one MSDF font
labs/pg-msdf-font.description: One pre-baked MSDF descriptor loads one atlas for one SDFText line.
walkthrough: FontLoader.msdf loads the pre-baked Roboto descriptor before SDFText is constructed.
The resulting glyph atlas remains crisp as the camera scale changes. No second font is loaded for comparison.
experiments: Change fontSize while keeping the generated font object unchanged.

labs/pg-audio-cue.title: Schedule one sound effect
labs/pg-audio-cue.description: Click the circle to place one generated tone on the SFX timeline.
walkthrough: AudioPlugin provides the scene audio buses. The scene creates a short in-memory tone so no network asset is involved.
The click schedules that buffer at the current scene time. The small scale pulse only confirms the same cue visually.
experiments: Change frequency from 440 to 660 while leaving duration and volume fixed.

labs/pg-tts-subtitles.title: Speak one captioned sentence
labs/pg-tts-subtitles.description: One TTS request and one subtitle component share the scene timeline.
walkthrough: speak requests one Microsoft Edge voice and awaits the returned duration.
Subtitles receives the same utterance timing. No background music, automaton or multi-beat presentation is included.
experiments: Change only speed from 0.96 to 0.8 and compare caption timing.
requirements: Microsoft Edge narration requires the /api/tts/msedge service from the Retiam development server.

labs/pg-svg.title: Parse one SVG document
labs/pg-svg.description: A single inline star becomes Retiam vector geometry.
walkthrough: SVG reads the document's viewBox, path data, fill and stroke into one vector hierarchy.
The parsed contour renders directly. No remote fetch, sketch conversion or atlas is involved.
experiments: Change one path point and inspect the resulting silhouette.

labs/pg-texture-atlas.title: Select one atlas frame
labs/pg-texture-atlas.description: A two-cell atlas yields one named amber SubTexture.
walkthrough: TextureAtlas combines a canvas with a TexturePacker-style manifest.
Sprite displays only the named amber frame, making UV selection the sole mechanism under study.
experiments: Change getTexture from amber to cyan without changing the Sprite size.

labs/pg-plugin.title: One plugin owns one updater
labs/pg-plugin.description: RotationPlugin installs and disposes the task that turns one tile.
walkthrough: Scene.use calls the plugin's install hook. The returned AlwaysHandle stays inside the plugin.
dispose stops that exact handle, so the behavior has a clear lifecycle owner.
experiments: Halve the radians-per-frame multiplier and compare rotation speed.

labs/pg-post-process.title: One full-frame luminance pass
labs/pg-post-process.description: A single post-process leaves the left side colored and converts the right side to grayscale.
walkthrough: PostProcessPass reads renderer.finalOutputHandle and writes one presentation output.
Its fragment code computes luminance once and selects that value only on the right, giving the effect a direct before/after comparison.
experiments: Return color unchanged to verify that geometry and materials were not modified.

labs/pg-procedural-helix.title: One procedural 3D helix
labs/pg-procedural-helix.description: Radius, pitch and turns define one tube mesh.
walkthrough: Helix3D generates the mesh directly from four geometric parameters.
The update rotates the completed mesh only so its depth is visible; it does not alter the helix definition.
experiments: Double pitch while leaving radius and turn count fixed.

labs/pg-text-split.title: Split one sentence into words
labs/pg-text-split.description: Only the second word moves after Text.splitWords creates independent entities.
walkthrough: splitWords replaces the original sentence with word-level Text entities at matching positions.
Moving the cyan word demonstrates its independent transform without mixing line, character or LaTeX splitting.
experiments: Move the first word instead and verify the second remains in place.

labs/pg-path-tracing.title: Accumulate one path-traced material
labs/pg-path-tracing.description: One metallic sphere is the only subject in the progressive raytracing pipeline.
walkthrough: raytraceEnabled selects the compute path-tracing pipeline and rtMaxAccumulation limits progressive sampling.
The sphere's metallic and roughness values affect the same fixed subject; no model loading or fallback scene is involved.
experiments: Increase roughness from 0.12 to 0.6 and compare the reflected highlight.

labs/pg-scene-event.title: Handle one scene-level click
labs/pg-scene-event.description: One Scene.setEvent callback moves one marker to the clicked world position.
walkthrough: InteractionManager converts the pointer location into scene coordinates.
The scene-level click handler changes only the marker transform.
experiments: Click near each corner and compare the marker position.

labs/pg-time-scale.title: Slow one scene clock
labs/pg-time-scale.description: One orbit visibly slows and resumes while its motion rule remains unchanged.
walkthrough: The updater derives position from scene time.
animateTimeScale changes the rate of that clock rather than editing the orbit.
experiments: Change the slow target from 0.2 to 0.5.

labs/pg-animator.title: Build one target-state animation
labs/pg-animator.description: Entity.animate moves one rectangle to one target position.
walkthrough: The animator records the requested target state.
Scene.play applies duration and easing to that single state change.
experiments: Change only the target x coordinate.

labs/pg-camera-frame.title: Frame one subject
labs/pg-camera-frame.description: Camera.frame centers and fits one off-center rectangle.
walkthrough: The rectangle begins away from the world origin.
Camera.frame derives the view from its bounds and one padding value.
experiments: Increase padding from 0.25 to 0.4.

labs/pg-material.title: Style one 3D material
labs/pg-material.description: One sphere exposes material color, metallic response and roughness.
walkthrough: The sphere geometry remains fixed.
Only Material properties determine the visible surface response.
experiments: Set metallic to 0 while keeping roughness fixed.

labs/pg-linechart.title: Plot one line series
labs/pg-linechart.description: Five numeric samples become one LineChart.
walkthrough: The explicit domains keep the axes fixed.
A single series supplies every line segment and dot.
experiments: Change the middle y value from 2 to 4.

labs/pg-areachart.title: Fill one area series
labs/pg-areachart.description: Five numeric samples become one AreaChart region.
walkthrough: The line defines the top edge of the area.
fillOpacity changes only the region beneath that line.
experiments: Change fillOpacity from 0.32 to 0.12.

labs/pg-scene-update.title: Update one entity each frame
labs/pg-scene-update.description: Scene.update derives one dot position from engine time.
walkthrough: The override calls super.update so normal scene processing continues.
The supplied time controls only the dot's horizontal position.
experiments: Change the divisor from 700 to 350.

labs/pg-add-compute.title: Queue one compute dispatch
labs/pg-add-compute.description: One compute kernel writes the colors displayed by one shader surface.
walkthrough: ComputeKernel writes 64 color values into one storage buffer.
Scene.addCompute queues that dispatch before the surface reads the same buffer.
experiments: Swap the red and blue expressions in the kernel.

labs/pg-text-load-fonts.title: Load one vector font
labs/pg-text-load-fonts.description: Text.loadFonts prepares one font before one Text entity is created.
walkthrough: The loader awaits one local TTF asset.
The following Text constructor uses the loaded global vector font.
experiments: Replace the displayed words without changing the font URL.

labs/pg-text-paths.title: Expose text glyph paths
labs/pg-text-paths.description: Text.getPaths returns the glyph paths of one short word.
walkthrough: getPaths decomposes the original vector text into glyph entities.
Moving one cyan glyph proves that the returned paths are independent.
experiments: Move a different returned glyph.

labs/pg-text-rebuild.title: Rebuild one vector word
labs/pg-text-rebuild.description: Text.rebuild regenerates the same word after one size change.
walkthrough: fontSize changes the requested vector geometry scale.
rebuild replaces the old generated paths with the new geometry.
experiments: Change the rebuilt font size from 1.3 to 0.9.

labs/pg-sdf-text.title: Construct one SDF text line
labs/pg-sdf-text.description: One SDFText constructor call produces one texture-backed label.
walkthrough: The text, font size and anchor are supplied once.
No vector-path conversion or font generation is involved.
experiments: Change the label while keeping its size fixed.

labs/pg-sdf-rebuild.title: Rebuild one SDF text line
labs/pg-sdf-rebuild.description: SDFText.rebuild regenerates one label after its size changes.
walkthrough: fontSize is changed on the existing entity.
rebuild replaces its generated glyph geometry once.
experiments: Rebuild at a smaller font size.

labs/pg-sdf-subentities.title: Expose SDF glyph entities
labs/pg-sdf-subentities.description: SDFText.getSubEntities returns three independently transformable glyphs.
walkthrough: The method decomposes one short label into SDFChar children.
Only the middle glyph is recolored and moved.
experiments: Transform the first glyph instead of the middle glyph.

labs/pg-entity-always.title: Attach one entity updater
labs/pg-entity-always.description: Entity.always makes one rectangle own its rotation behavior.
walkthrough: The callback belongs to the rectangle's lifecycle.
Its dt value controls only incremental rotation.
experiments: Halve the dt multiplier.

labs/pg-always-options.title: Throttle one scene updater
labs/pg-always-options.description: AlwaysOptions.interval makes one dot advance four times per second.
walkthrough: Scene.always owns one position update.
The interval option makes the stepping rate visible without changing the path.
experiments: Change interval from 250 to 500 milliseconds.

labs/pg-scene-play.title: Play one animation
labs/pg-scene-play.description: Scene.play applies one duration and easing function to one moving dot.
walkthrough: Entity.animate supplies the target position.
The AnimOptions object controls timing without adding another animation.
experiments: Replace easeInOutCubic with linear easing.

labs/pg-animator-pause.title: Pause one animator
labs/pg-animator-pause.description: One moving dot pauses in place, holds, and resumes on the same Animator.
walkthrough: The entity creates one target-state animator.
pause and resume change only that animator's clock.
experiments: Double the paused wait while leaving the movement duration unchanged.

labs/pg-component-update.title: Update one component
labs/pg-component-update.description: One Component.update method rotates its owning rectangle.
walkthrough: The Spin component contains the behavior and no rendering code.
Its dt input is converted from milliseconds before rotation is applied.
experiments: Change the rotation multiplier without editing the rectangle.

labs/pg-shader.title: Draw one procedural shader
labs/pg-shader.description: One Shader fragment blends two colors across one retained quad.
walkthrough: input.uv supplies normalized coordinates across the surface.
The fragment body writes one finalColor and uses no external resources.
experiments: Swap input.uv.x for input.uv.y.

labs/pg-barchart-data.title: Animate one bar-chart dataset
labs/pg-barchart-data.description: BarChart.animateData changes only the three values of one existing chart.
walkthrough: The category count and order stay fixed.
Only bar heights and their value labels move to the replacement values.
experiments: Change only the middle target value.

labs/pg-barchart-animate-in.title: Reveal one bar chart
labs/pg-barchart-animate-in.description: BarChart.animateIn reveals the values of one existing chart from its baseline.
walkthrough: The chart is built once from three category/value pairs.
animateIn changes only the visibility and height of those same bars.
experiments: Double the duration while leaving the data unchanged.

labs/pg-value-tracker.title: Animate one tracked number
labs/pg-value-tracker.description: One ValueTracker supplies the x coordinate of one dot.
walkthrough: ValueTracker stores no visible geometry.
The updater reads value and maps that single scalar to the dot position.
experiments: Reverse the start and target values.

labs/pg-axes-conversion.title: Round-trip one axes coordinate
labs/pg-axes-conversion.description: Axes.c2p and Axes.p2c convert one point out and back.
walkthrough: c2p maps the mathematical coordinate to the axes rectangle.
p2c recovers the same numbers before the marker is positioned.
experiments: Change the source coordinate from (1.5, 1) to (-2, -1).

labs/pg-function-graph.title: Sample one function graph
labs/pg-function-graph.description: One FunctionGraph2D maps a sine function through one Axes instance.
walkthrough: Axes defines the mathematical domain and visible rectangle.
FunctionGraph2D samples only the supplied sine function.
experiments: Replace Math.sin(x) with Math.cos(x).

labs/pg-function-update.title: Replace one graph function
labs/pg-function-update.description: FunctionGraph2D.setFunction changes one sine curve into one straight line.
walkthrough: The axes and graph entity stay in place.
setFunction replaces the sampled function and rebuilds only the curve.
experiments: Use x => x * x * 0.2 as the replacement.

labs/pg-orbit-controller.title: Control one orbit camera
labs/pg-orbit-controller.description: One OrbitCameraController targets one sphere with one camera.
walkthrough: The camera begins at one known position looking at the origin.
The controller owns only orbit, pan and zoom input for that camera.
experiments: Change only the controller radius.

labs/pg-frame-graph.title: Declare one frame-graph dependency
labs/pg-frame-graph.description: A vignette pass reads the presentation output of one luminance pass.
walkthrough: The first pass reads the renderer output.
The second pass consumes the first pass handle, creating one explicit edge.
experiments: Remove the vignette pass and compare the output.

labs/pg-performance.title: Isolate transform-update cost
labs/pg-performance.description: One toggle pauses transform updates while retained entity count stays fixed.
walkthrough: The scene creates its 120 circles once.
The toggle changes only whether their positions are recomputed.
experiments: Compare 120 and 240 circles at the same preview size.
